fullPassage: Even before telescopes existed, people looked out into space and tried to understand the universe. The Egyptians, Babylonians, Greeks, and Maya were among the first peoples to map the movements of the stars. In Europe, a 16th-century Polish mathematician named Nicolaus Copernicus put forth a revolutionary idea. Copernicus watched the stars and took measurements by eye. He concluded that the view of the universe accepted at the time ─ that the Sun traveled around Earth ─ was wrong, and that it was in fact Earth that traveled around the Sun. Despite widespread objections to his ideas, he published his theory in a book. Later astronomers built on Copernicus’ work. Technological improvements led to the development of the telescope in the early 17th century. Using a telescope, the Italian scientist Galileo Galilei discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter and observed craters on Earth’s Moon. He also confirmed that Copernicus’ theory was correct. Over the centuries, scientific discoveries and information from telescopes advanced our knowledge of how the universe works.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① accepting → accepted: 'the view ~ accepted at the time'은 '당시 받아들여지던 관점'으로, 관점이 사람들에게 '받아들여지는' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 accepted
det.analysis:

② led: 'Technological improvements led to the development'는 '기술 향상이 개발로 이어졌다'예요. 과거의 일이라 과거형 led가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ confirmed: 'He also confirmed that ~'은 '그는 또한 ~을 확인했다'예요. 과거의 일이라 과거형 confirmed가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

❌ ① by mistake(실수로): 지구가 실수로 돈다는 뜻이 되어 어색해요.

det.korean: he published his theory in a book
det.analysis:
'그는 ~을 출판했다'가 핵심이라 '주어(he) + 동사(published)'로 시작해요.

무엇을 출판했는가 하면 목적어 'his theory(자신의 이론)'예요: his → theory.

'책으로(책의 형태로)'는 in a book으로 나타내요: in → a → book.

순서대로 이으면 he / published / his / theory / in / a / book → 'he published his theory in a book'.
det.tip: publish A in a book = A를 책으로 출판하다

"그리고 사실은 (다름 아닌) 지구가 태양 주위를 도는 것이었다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) around, Earth, fact, in, it, Sun, that, the, traveled, was 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것 (3) 'It was ~ that ...' 강조구문으로 쓸 것

det.korean: it was in fact Earth that traveled around the Sun
det.analysis:
핵심은 '실제로 태양 주위를 돈 것은 바로 지구였다'라며 Earth(지구)를 강조하는 문장이에요. 이럴 때는 'It was + 강조할 말 + that ...' 강조구문을 써요.

먼저 It was로 시작하고, '사실은'을 뜻하는 in fact를 넣어요: it → was → in → fact.

강조할 대상 Earth를 놓고, 그 뒤를 that으로 이어요: Earth → that.

questions.passage: Even before telescopes existed, __________. The Egyptians, Babylonians, Greeks, and Maya were among the first peoples to map the movements of the stars. In Europe, a 16th-century Polish mathematician named Nicolaus Copernicus put forth a revolutionary idea. Copernicus watched the stars and took measurements by eye. He concluded that the view of the universe accepted at the time ─ that the Sun traveled around Earth ─ was wrong, and that it was in fact Earth that traveled around the Sun. Despite widespread objections to his ideas, he published his theory in a book. Later astronomers built on Copernicus’ work. Technological improvements led to the development of the telescope in the early 17th century. Using a telescope, the Italian scientist Galileo Galilei discovered the four largest moons of Jupiter and observed craters on Earth’s Moon. He also confirmed that Copernicus’ theory was correct. Over the centuries, scientific discoveries and information from telescopes advanced our knowledge of how the universe works.

그리고 and로 두 번째 동작을 이어요: and + tried(노력했다).

무엇을 하려 했는가 하면 to understand the universe(우주를 이해하려)예요: to → understand → the → universe.

순서대로 이으면 people / looked / out / into / space / and / tried / to / understand / the / universe.
